objections.claim: The D-054 review must bind one immutable prompt and one immutable subject whose dispatched digest equals both the review-start and review-end digest.
objections.evidence: At 2026-08-14T11:08:36-0700, the prompt sha256 was cef40abb32188fe9dbf7e8c574bfd28ab1cc6dd2542c80a7ad7d9c3cd4295000 and dispatched subject digest was 7d10d8f427b4dfe06a618ea2aaefb383ca1cab1d7da09eef745cbe4c5f66cc57; the subject matched. The subject mtime then moved at 11:08:55 to sha256 0224356d653e0d12705c92e288761e15ed1289f5ca8cdf57e7f7c34c19ccfc67, repairing the pin and adding D-049/D-050 prose. At 11:09:18 the prompt itself moved to sha256 78ec88772b254a823ce6dbad76564b5c124cd829debc6e06870537420a0b3a37 and rewrote the expected digest to 0224356d.... Thus start and end bytes differ and the original cited-digest failure was repaired inside the active review rather than through a new frozen turn.
objections.proposedFix: Stop editing both files, preserve this turn as OBJECTIONS, and dispatch a turn-2 prompt against a newly named frozen subject with one explicit digest. Require every reviewer to measure that same digest at start and end. Do not rewrite a dispatched prompt or subject in place.

objections.claim: A D-038-form coordinator-recording decision and a later owner-recording decision must remain separately committed at decision granularity.
objections.evidence: D-054 lines 48-50 permit the owner-recording entry to be written in the same commit as the coordinator recording, while lines 82-84 say the owner entry is its own D-000 cycle. Adopted D-000 lines 39-42 require commit and push per decision so each decision can be rolled back or cherry-picked independently. A D-038-form coordinator recording is itself a D-000 register decision, so the same-commit branch combines two decisions and defeats the user's explicit granularity rule.
objections.proposedFix: Delete the same-commit alternative. Require the exact coordinator recording to be adopted and separately committed before the owner-recording cycle begins; require the later entry to pin that decision ID and commit.

objections.claim: Every owner recording authorized by D-054 must incorporate the exact operative disposition recorded by the coordinator, including all adopted riders and any binding advisory dispositions, rather than merely naming the candidate file and reviews.
objections.evidence: D-054 lines 46-53 accept ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES and require only owner role, candidate path/digest, verdict paths/digests, preview scope, and Route A remainder. D-054 line 67 includes DR-005. Adopted D-039 lines 1927-1943 state that DR-005's subject is v2 plus the adopted RB-DR005-V2-A1 rider, that the rider is operative disposition text, and that condition 1 cannot discharge until owners record v2 plus that rider. An owner entry can satisfy D-054's listed minimum while recording only v2, which would violate D-039 and falsely claim condition-1 discharge.
objections.proposedFix: Require the owner entry to pin the coordinator-recording decision and commit and to reproduce or unambiguously incorporate every operative rider/advisory disposition. Name DR-005 explicitly as v2 plus RB-DR005-V2-A1. For any ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES case, require each advisory to be classified as non-operative or carried into the owner record.

objections.claim: D-054's overturn procedure should quantify over every dependent owner recording and any dependent MF-6 note, not one singular recording.
objections.evidence: The grant covers five currently eligible rows and can later cover three more. Lines 102-104 say only that after 'one' owner recording lands, overturn requires 'that recording's' supersession. This does not state the required state after two or more recordings use the grant, nor how a file-08 note that depends on a superseded recording is reconciled.
objections.proposedFix: State that revoking future authority is C-D054, while undoing effects also requires superseding every owner recording that cites D-054 and reconciling each dependent MF-6 file-08 note under its own reviewed act.

objections.claim: The subject status must describe dispatched review bytes accurately.
objections.evidence: Line 3 of both observed subject versions says 'DRAFT — not yet dispatched' even though this prompt is the D-054 turn-1 dispatch. The register's review trail relies on status/protocol text to distinguish pre-dispatch drafts from frozen under-review subjects.
objections.proposedFix: Change the next frozen subject's status to 'DRAFT — under review' and identify it as turn 2 if the hot repair is carried forward.
